interest: Shows 1930s Japan forcing Western firms like B.F. Goodrich and Victor to sell to Japanese syndicates amid rising economic nationalism.
keywords: Victor Talking Machine Company of Japan
overview: Docket sheets for file 894.5034 (1930-1939) track Japanese economic nationalism: forced sales of Yokohama Rubber, Nipponophone, and Victor Talking Machine of Japan to Japan Industry Company, dividend caps, Article 11 of the National Mobilization Law, and a Business Profits Tax dispute involving Butler Brothers.
